info.title: Mootz Dots API
info.description: Private offchain Meet markers. One Dot is created atomically by each valid Meet, never by this API. Hidden and not_saved Dots still count; counts do not imply chain records or unique humans. No currency, rewards or frame thresholds.

get.description: Participants and accepted friends of the poster only. Scanner-only friends receive no access. map=true excludes hidden Dots, moments without shared location consent and Meets without a retained approximate display area. General lists retain hidden Dots for the same authorized audience; hidden_by is never disclosed. Cursor is scoped to viewer, momentId and map and uses millisecond timestamp plus UUID ordering.

put.summary: Participant hides or restores a Dot map marker
put.description: Either participant may hide a visible Dot. Only the participant who hid it may restore it. A repeated hide by its owner is idempotent; another participant cannot acquire restoration rights by hiding again. Dot remains in authorized lists and counts. Concurrent changes serialize.

404.description: Dot absent or actor is not a participant

get.summary: Own Dot count and distinct account partner count
get.description: Includes hidden and not_saved Dots. Not an arbitrary profile lookup or chain-derived count.

recorded.description: True for matching provisional or finalized chain inclusion. Use finality=finalized and chainOutcome=success before describing the record as final.

location.description: Approximate 200 m Meet area center, retained only when moment location is shared. Never the photo location or raw Meet verification GPS or area key. Null for legacy rows without a display area; no photo-coordinate fallback
